method: External authoritative API contract, separately from shipping EXE source and loaded native module behavior

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: _aligned_malloc
sources.paraphrase: The documented size/alignment allocation can return a null pointer on failure. Alignment must be a power of two. Resource exhaustion is one documented failure condition. Zero size or invalid alignment belongs to the parameter-validation path.
sources.selected_claim: For the original nonzero 80000-byte, alignment16 request, the documented API contract does not guarantee nonnull normal return.
sources.limits: Not a hash or inspection of the FF12-loaded CRT DLL, not an observed FF12 allocation failure or error handler. No errno capture. Apply only under an unmodified IAT binding implementing this API contract.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: _aligned_free
sources.paraphrase: The documented one-pointer void function releases memory from the aligned allocation APIs. Its native effects depend on a valid allocation pointer.
sources.selected_claim: The wrapper's tail is the named aligned release import, not evidence of a size-aware native release contract or valid ownership.
sources.limits: No claim that a particular pointer was valid, released, reused or harmless in FF12. Local null-pointer skipping is established from shipping instructions independently.
